description: Defines the cSettings class for managing configuration settings via JSON stored in a file, including methods for reading, writing, and manipulating key-value pairs.

classes.name: cSettings
classes.description: A class for handling configuration settings stored in a JSON format within a file, providing methods for access, modification, and persistence.

methods.name: cSettings
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the settings object, creating the file if it does not exist.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key from the JSON data.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set a key's value with string, int, or bool types, then writes changes to the file.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists and is non-empty in the JSON data.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the JSON data and updates the file.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Serializes the JSON data to the file if it exists.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Initializes JSON data from the configuration file.
